name: Comptable de caravane

prompt:

Working logistics specialist in calm idle stance, not combat. All baggage must be physically attached, held or strapped; no loose items around character. Crisp silhouette, detailed convincing textiles and weathered metal, soft overhead-left lighting. Full body head-to-toes and ALL equipment must fit inside frame with at least8% empty margin every side; do not crop. Genuine transparent alpha background. No scenery, backdrop, ground, platform, floor shadow, glow cloud, text, readable writing, numbers, labels, watermark, border, extra person, collage or atlas. No magical staff. At ordinary game sprite scale, face, posture, clothes and cargo shape must distinguish this person.
